```php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Bookmark;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ApiController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Bookmark $bookmark)
    {
        return response()->json($bookmark->paginate());
    }

    public function store(Request $request, Bookmark $bookmark)
    {
        $bookmark->create($request->all());

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Bookmark created successfully']);
    }

    public function show(User $user)
    {
        return response()->json($user);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, User $user)
    {
        $user->update($request->all());

        return response()->json(['message' => 'User updated successfully']);
    }

    public function destroy(User $user)
    {
        $user->delete();

        return response()->json(['message' => 'User deleted successfully']);
    }
}
```
